response.original_title: All Creatures Great and Small - The Night Before Christmas
response.overview: Season 1 Christmas Special - James still has feelings for Helen and is struggling to cope as she prepares to get married to Hugh. On Christmas Eve James is called out to help a dog struggling to give birth and Helen volunteers to come along. But a thick fog comes over the Dales and it looks like the pair will be trapped together.
response.title: All Creatures Great and Small - The Night Before Christmas
